szoveg_eredeti:
The world’s premier AI Festival returns.

AIF 2027 will once again celebrate the work being made with AI across Film, Design, Fashion, Advertising and Gaming. With gala screenings in New York, Los Angeles and Tokyo.

Submissions are now open at https://aif.runway.com
